Travelers: Companion Animal Travel Desk notice

Travelers should confirm their pet details with Aurelia Skyways before departure so that care can be arranged without delay.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk supports each journey from booking through pickup, and our team works to keep guidance clear, kind, and practical. Please share any special handling needs as soon as they are known, and keep your contact details current so our staff can reach you promptly if support is needed. Respectful communication helps us coordinate smoothly with airport partners and with the teams that receive each animal on arrival.

If your travel plans change, or if you need reassurance about documents, carrier preparation, or arrival procedures, please contact the desk directly. We will review your request, explain the next step in plain words, and help you prepare for a calmer trip. Travelers are also encouraged to keep any approved items organized and ready for inspection when asked.

For help with companion animal travel, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
